visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty three: a baker's dozen (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js bakery with a chalkboard that takes a live tally, box-built character, contract / sent folder counted twice / brand email / which ones / campaign page / post list pages, a tray of rolls, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: the contract says twelve videos; she counts eleven, then thirteen; the brand counts nine; some did not count and nobody says which; so she keeps a tally on the wall. Then YourBrand: the campaign page keeps count (Delivered 7 / 12, Days left 9) and every post says Counted or Not counted. It was thirteen: a baker's dozen.
